title: Unit Event — Cast a Spell on You — Episode4 Everyone's Designs

meta.Event Outline: Having held their real-life event, Shizuku and the others feel that their bond with their fans has grown even stronger. While exploring ideas with their fans, one of them suggests making MORE MORE JUMP! stage outfits as their next endeavor!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Are your designs ready?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not quite... I managed to come up with a few ideas, but nothing solid yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same.
I used my old QT outfit and what other idols wear as reference to come up with some rough sketches.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, I wanna see what you came up with!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't mind, but again, they're rough sketches, so try not to be disappointed, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Here. They should be in this sketchbook.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This looks so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...!
The frills on it even look like a heart.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right! This one's heart-themed!
But that's not all. Notice anything else?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it supposed to do something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Dancing's a big part of being an idol, right? So, I tried making it so these look good while we do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, the hearts on the skirt should really draw everyone's eyes when we jump...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And whenever we spin or turn, they'll bloom open like flowers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...!
On top of being cute, they do all these cool tricks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Airi, these already seem incredible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, they still need a lot of work and I plan on making them even better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind showing me what you've all come up with?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, here are my ideas!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Lemme see...
Hey, this one's flower themed! It looks adorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's one of the outfits I've always wanted to wear if I ever did become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... In a way, this is a representation of your hopes and dreams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I have other outfits that I really want to see you three wear too, Haruka, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, found it!
They're really designed just for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they look pretty different from each other. Won't we look a little weird when we're all together on stage?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I need to think more about us as MORE MORE JUMP! when I'm designing these, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's the hard part.
I've come up with some ideas too, but nothing that really satisfies me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, I wanna see your ideas...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. Here.
I'm thinking about redrawing them, so I doubt they'll be of much help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!
This is so cute! Snazzy too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, these seem easy to move around in, like when we're doing tough dance sequences and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually had sort of the same idea as you in terms of having an outfit that can handle any dance routine, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An outfit that's suited for anything from ballads to high-tempo songs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means you put quite a lot of thought into this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you can tell Haruka came up with this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time... We'd be sacrificing some of our identity for mobility...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's the thing.
I need to find a way to work in our colors more to give them that MORE MORE JUMP! feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Our identity...
Hmm... That's so hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I'm really impressed by how you've all come up with such intricate designs in such a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi's outfit does all these neat tricks, Minori's is absolutely adorable and Haruka's gives us the freedom to dance to any song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You three have come up with some wonderful designs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Shizuku, how about your design?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me? Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I don't have anything yet. I'm still not sure which design would be best for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been looking at some of the outfits other idols wear, but trying to find something that works for us made me even more lost...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That's okay. We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She's right!
Let's just take it one step at a time until we have to present everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're still in the middle of figuring out our own designs, so I'm sure you'll think of something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Based on what we all showed each other today, we're clearly looking at this from very different angles.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no right answer, so I say take as many liberties as you like when coming up with a design.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By doing so, I'm sure you'll be able to come up with the outfit you really want to design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The outfit I really want to design...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see. Thank you for your input.
I'll give it another try later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great, and good luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to start over from scratch too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's both keep trying our best, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We need to design the best outfits ever since our fans are gonna be making them!
